title: Unimodular Equivalence of Integral Simplices
summary: Testing the unimodular equivalence of two full-dimensional integral simplices can be reduced to testing unimodular permutation (UP) equivalence of two nonsingular matrices. We conduct a systematic study of UP-equivalence, which leads to the first average-case quasi-polynomial time algorithm, called \texttt{HEM}, for deciding the unimodular equivalence of $d$-dimensional integral simplices, as well as achieving a polynomial-time complexity with a failure probability less than $2.5 \times 10^{-7}$.
